title: TESS transit candidates 2026: TIC 402710280 and TIC 324429952
description: Transit timing, light-curve tables, false-positive checks, TRICERATOPS runs and predicted transit times for two transit candidates found in TESS full-frame images: TIC 402710280 (Gaia DR3 5828441289812582400; P = 36.34005 d, depth about 1680 ppm, 5.3 h, transit-timing variations up to 29 min; two archival HARPS epochs) and TIC 324429952 (Gaia DR3 6416596855786566528; P = 42.37574 d, depth about 1500 ppm). The tables are recomputed from public MAST, Gaia and ESO archive products by the scripts in the repository. AI-produced, not peer reviewed; the candidates are not confirmed.
notes: Not peer reviewed. Produced by AI models under the direction of the repository owner; see AI_DISCLOSURE.md. Data, figures and text: CC BY 4.0; scripts: MIT.
